title: Battle of Chappar Chiri
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Chappar Chiri", at revision 1370108903, opens: "The Battle of Chappar Chiri, also called Battle of Sirhind, was fought between Mughal Empire and the Sikhs on 12 May 1710 at Chappar Chiri, located 20 kilometers from Sirhind." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q21244901, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "battle between Sikh and Mughal forces". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
